## Shared `__VPRO_PlotClimate` Cache and `CoordElevHash`

`vpro` and `vpro_wails` share the exact same `__VPRO_PlotClimate` SQLite table and 16-byte SHA-256 `CoordElevHash` key (`lat|lon|elev|ref_period`). Plots downscaled in R via `climr` (or evaluated with the offline BGC lapse fallback when working offline) are immediate cache hits in `vpro_wails` and vice-versa:

```{r}
library(vpro)

con <- vpro_sample()
vpro_coord_elev_hash(lat = 54.25, lon = -126.75, elev = 650, ref_period = "1961_1990")

clim <- vpro_climate(con, ref_period = "1961_1990", cache = FALSE, force_offline = TRUE)
head(clim[, c("PlotNumber", "BGC", "Elevation", "MAT", "MAP", "MSP", "CMD", "PAS")])
```

## Ministry `CMD -> aSMR` Water-Balance Transfer Function

`vpro_asmr()` applies the Ministry water-balance rules (`aSMR_Rules_HalfStep.csv`): 5-month summer moist surplus (`PPT_05..09 >= 90 mm`), dormant-season recharge deficit (`350 - (PPT_at + PPT_wt)`), steep (`> 35%`) warm SW (`1.25x`) and cool N (`0.85x`) aspect adjustments, and shedding/receiving `rSMR` step transforms:

```{r}
asmr_df <- vpro_asmr(con, ref_period = "1961_1990", cache = FALSE, force_offline = TRUE)
head(asmr_df[, c("PlotNumber", "SiteUnit", "rSMR", "rSNR", "CMD", "CMD_site", "aSMR")])
```

## Dual Relative and Actual `9 x 5` Edatopic Grids

`vpro_edatopic_grid(mode = "dual")` computes paired Relative (`rSMR x rSNR`) and Actual (`aSMR x rSNR`) `9 x 5` grids along with species prominence tiers, rendered with B.C. Government `#003366` / `#FCBA19` styling via `plot_edatope()`:

```{r}
ed <- vpro_edatopic_grid(con, mode = "dual", force_offline = TRUE)
ed

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  plot_edatope(ed)
}
```

## Publishing Self-Contained Quarto BEC Field Guides

`vpro_render_guide()` compiles standalone HTML or PDF site-unit guides, BGC subzone synopses, vegetation summary books, and QC audit reports with embedded `BC Sans` typography, dual edatopic SVGs, and 8-sector aspect roses:

```{r}
out_guide <- tempfile("unit-guide-", fileext = ".html")
art <- vpro_render_guide(con, type = "single_unit", output_file = out_guide, force_offline = TRUE)
art
unlink(out_guide)
```
